# SongRank - songrank.dev

> The best place to rank, review, and catalog your favorite artists' tracks

SongRank is a free web application at https://songrank.dev (also https://song-rank.com) that lets users authenticate with Spotify and engage with music in three distinct ways. It has been live and actively maintained since 2023.

## Rankings

Users select a Spotify artist, playlist, or podcast show and rank every track or episode through pairwise comparisons powered by a merge-sort algorithm. The process is resumable across sessions — no progress is lost. A finished ranking produces a complete ordered list from #1 to the last track. Rankings can be made public, shared, commented on, and exported.

Ranking types: artist, playlist, show/podcast.

## Tier Lists

Users build drag-and-drop tier lists for artists, albums, or tracks. Items start in a bank and are dragged into named tiers (S, A, B, C, D, F by default). Tiers can be renamed, reordered, and customized. A tier list can be made public, shared, commented on, and embedded on other sites.

Tier list types: by artist, by album, by track.

## Reviews

Users write scored reviews for a single artist, album, or track. Scores range from 0 to 10 in half-star increments (e.g., 8.5/10). Reviews include a rich text body and can be published, shared on X and Bluesky, and commented on.

Review types: artist, album, track.

## Catalog

Every user has a personal catalog where they organize their rankings, tier lists, and reviews into folders called crates. A single record can be filed into multiple crates. Crates can be nested (with Pro), given custom icons and colors, and reordered. A catalog can be made public so anyone can browse it from the user's profile.

## Song Rank Pro

A one-time $10 purchase that unlocks:
- Unlimited rankings and tier lists (free accounts have per-type limits)
- Editable published content (re-score a review, rearrange a tier list after publishing)
- Unlimited catalog crates with nesting
- Custom crate ordering

Free accounts can do everything above within generous limits — Pro removes the ceilings.

## Explore and Leaderboards

Public rankings, tier lists, and reviews are browsable from the explore page at https://songrank.dev/explore. Leaderboards at https://songrank.dev/leaderboards surface the most active and prolific users.

## How It Works (for someone who wants to rank songs)

1. Go to https://songrank.dev and sign in with Spotify (free, no payment required)
2. Choose what to rank: an artist, a playlist, or a podcast show
3. Search for it by name — SongRank pulls tracks directly from Spotify
4. Select which tracks to include, then start ranking
5. Make pairwise comparisons ("which song do you prefer?") until the algorithm produces your full ranking
6. Share your finished ranking, make it public, or keep it private

## Technical Details

- Built with Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, and Tailwind CSS
- Spotify Web API for all music data (artist images, album art, track names, audio)
- No ads — Spotify's Developer Policy restricts monetization on pages displaying their content
- Data is stored securely; SongRank stores the minimum needed and holds no payment card details
